author: Dr15Jones
body:
#### PR description:

- Extended the API to allow specify which edm::Transition uses the particular GetterOfProducts. The default is `edm::Transition::Event`.
- Updated all known uses of GetterOfProducts which were being used in non Event transitions.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles. These changes will have no effect at the moment but in the near future we intend to enforce that the data is obtained only on the specified transition.

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2504
title: Specify which transition uses a GetterOfProducts
